verses.verse:
रिध कोमल रागेषु सौविध्याय सुरैषिणाम्।
कृत्रिमौ कोमलौ कार्यौ वाद्ये रिषभधैवतौ।55।
verses.text: For the convenience of those who seek tunefulness, in rāgas with komal Re and Dha, an artificial komal Ṛṣabha and Dhaivata should be made on the instrument.

commentary.text: After the 12 notes in all have been placed in the flute by the rules above, a flute can be made and played, on the basis of those svarasthāna (note positions), with at least six and at most 10 holes. Even so, the problem of lifting half a finger for komal Ṛṣabha and Dhaivata could not be solved. So by a scientific method I made komal Re and Dha, and they also worked in playing. For this the holes of Re and Dha must be made smaller in some way. That device can be of any material: rubber, wood and so on.

terms.en: artificial komal note — Re or Dha made flat by narrowing its hole
